decisive_items: Multiple filamentous gram-positive bacilli identified on Gram stain
Recent activities included cleaning her fish tank, playing with her pet cat, and gardening in her indoor cactus garden
response.rationale: The candidate correctly identifies Nocardia infection based on the presence of filamentous gram-positive bacilli on Gram stain, the clinical context of recent hospitalization and environmental exposures (soil from cactus, fish tank, cat), and the negative acid-fast and PAS stains which rule out other organisms.
